title: podman wait
body:
### Issue Description

On WSL it hangs if one of the dependencies exit with a 0 code while on Windows it doesn't (as it should)

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue
1. compose.yaml dependencies section
2. one of the dependencies of a service must exit with 0 code
3. if not 0, it doesn't happen


### Describe the results you received

`INFO:podman_compose:['podman', 'wait', '--condition=running', 'testphp_php_1', 'testphp_postgres_1', 'testphp_pnpm_1', 'testphp_composer_1']` hangs forever because composer exit with 0 code

### Describe the results you expected

on Windows with podman compose it was working, if I'm not wrong

### podman info output

```yaml
podman-compose version 1.6.0
podman version 6.0.2
```

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Privileged

### Upstream Latest Release

No
